args.title: Treat quotes as starting a quoted field only at field start
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Fix CSV parsing so unquoted fields containing an inch mark or quote character (e.g., 27" Dell) do not incorrectly trigger quoted-field mode and swallow subsequent fields/lines. Treat a quote as opening a quoted field only when it appears at the start of a field.
